about.text: Reverend Kenneth Simon, Reverend Lewis W. Macklin, II, and Helen Youngblood (collectively, the “Simon Parties”) sued the Ohio Redistricting Commission and several of its members, including Governor Mike DeWine, Secretary of State Frank LaRose, Speaker of the Ohio House of Representatives Robert Cupp, President of the Ohio Senate Matthew Huffman, and Auditor Keith Faber (collectively, the “Ohio Redistricting Commission”).

caseName: Kenneth Simon, et al v. Mike DeWine, et al

documents.accessNote: Hosted by govinfo.gov; linked, not mirrored.
documents.title: Opinion of 2024-04-09

events.description: OPINION and JUDGMENT filed : The district court’s order denying the motion for a three-judge court is REVERSED, its grant of the motions to dismiss and denial of the motion for a temporary restraining order and for class certification are VACATED, and the case is REMANDED to the district court with directions for it immediately to initiate the procedures to convene a three-judge court under 28 U.S.C. § 2284. Mandate to issue. Decision for publication. Alice M. Batchelder, Karen Nelson Moore (AUTHORING), and Raymond M. Kethledge, Circuit Judges.
